failure_summary.description: Answered a related title, property, or entity rather than the clue's requested referent, including ignoring a proper-name and answer-length cue.
Returned an expanded name, full title, or overly precise time value instead of the expected conventional form or granularity.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already covers answer-slot and relationship checks, parenthetical length constraints, and concise conventional answer forms. These failures reflect non-adherence to those rules rather than a clear missing rule, so adding similar guidance would duplicate existing content.
